note: components: each definition's states, projected design-file states, variant axes, props (name, default, values), size rungs and size default. peerGroups: the three derived groupings. findings: every difference between peers, for the owner to judge — a finding is a difference, not a verdict.

peerGroups.name: Button
peerGroups.basis: components named Button or Button.<variant>, where the suffix is not a role

peerGroups.name: FlushIconButton
peerGroups.basis: components named FlushIconButton or FlushIconButton.<variant>, where the suffix is not a role

peerGroups.name: IconButton
peerGroups.basis: components named IconButton or IconButton.<variant>, where the suffix is not a role

peerGroups.name: button
peerGroups.basis: button and every component that inherits from it, directly or through another

peerGroups.name: button-destructive
peerGroups.basis: button-destructive and every component that inherits from it, directly or through another

peerGroups.name: button-neutral
peerGroups.basis: button-neutral and every component that inherits from it, directly or through another

peerGroups.name: text-field
peerGroups.basis: text-field and every component that inherits from it, directly or through another

findings.subject: role peers: *.Control
findings.detail: radio-control differs from the group's common set [disabled, error, focus-visible, hover, pressed, rest] — lacks error

findings.subject: role peers: *.Row
findings.detail: no state set is shared by most of the group — checkbox-row [rest, hover, pressed, focus-visible, disabled, read-only, error]; radio-row [rest, hover, pressed, focus-visible, disabled, read-only]; switch-row [rest, hover, pressed, pending, focus-visible, disabled, read-only, error]

findings.subject: substrate: button
findings.detail: flush-icon-button differs from the group's common set [disabled, focus-visible, hover, inactive, pending, pressed, rest] — lacks inactive, pending

findings.subject: substrate: button-destructive
findings.detail: flush-icon-button-destructive differs from the group's common set [disabled, focus-visible, hover, inactive, pending, pressed, rest] — lacks inactive, pending

findings.subject: substrate: button-neutral
findings.detail: flush-icon-button-neutral differs from the group's common set [disabled, focus-visible, hover, inactive, pending, pressed, rest] — lacks inactive, pending

findings.subject: substrate: text-field
findings.detail: no state set is shared by most of the group — checkbox-row [rest, hover, pressed, focus-visible, disabled, read-only, error]; radio-row [rest, hover, pressed, focus-visible, disabled, read-only]; switch-row [rest, hover, pressed, pending, focus-visible, disabled, read-only, error]; text-field [rest, hover, pending, filled, focus-visible, focus-visible-filled, disabled, read-only, empty]; textarea [rest, hover, pending, filled, focus-visible, focus-visible-filled, disabled, read-only, empty]

findings.subject: axis appearance
findings.detail: the appearance axis takes 2 value sets — [filled, ghost, outline] in icon-button, icon-button-destructive, icon-button-neutral; [filled, outline, text] in button, button-destructive, button-neutral

findings.subject: axis emphasis
findings.detail: the emphasis axis takes 2 value sets — [bold, subtle] in badge; [primary, secondary] in field-label

findings.subject: axis inset
findings.detail: the inset axis takes 2 value sets — [default, flush] in button, button-destructive, button-neutral; [inset, middle-inset, none] in divider

findings.subject: axis selection
findings.detail: the selection axis takes 4 value sets — [selected, unselected] in segmented-control-segment, tab, tag; [checked, indeterminate, unchecked] in checkbox-control; [checked, unchecked] in radio-control; [off, on] in switch-control

findings.subject: axis shape
findings.detail: the shape axis takes 2 value sets — [circular, square] in icon-button, icon-button-destructive, icon-button-neutral; [flush, round] in flush-icon-button, flush-icon-button-destructive, flush-icon-button-neutral

findings.subject: axis size
findings.detail: the size axis takes 3 value sets — [large, medium, small] in _accordion-indicator, accordion, button, button-destructive, button-neutral, checkbox-control, checkbox-group, checkbox-row, dialog, field-label, flush-icon-button, flush-icon-button-destructive, flush-icon-button-neutral, icon-button, icon-button-destructive, icon-button-neutral, link, list, list-item, password-field, radio-control, radio-group, radio-row, segmented-control, segmented-control-segment, select, tab, tabs, tag, text-field, textarea; [medium, small] in switch-control, switch-row; [large, medium, small, x-small] in spinner

findings.subject: axis style
findings.detail: the style axis takes 2 value sets — [outline] in password-field, text-field, textarea; [inline, standalone] in link

findings.subject: axis tone
findings.detail: the tone axis takes 2 value sets — [brand, danger, info, inherit, primary, secondary, success, tertiary, warning] in icon; [danger, info, neutral, success, warning] in badge

findings.subject: axis type
findings.detail: the type axis takes 3 value sets — [icon, ordered, unordered] in list, list-item; [count, dot, status] in badge; [dismissible, select] in tag

findings.subject: axis weight
findings.detail: the weight axis takes 2 value sets — [bold, regular] in field-label; [default, emphasis] in link
